newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in afternoon trading Wednesday as buyers retreated and profit-takers emerged after the previous day's jump to a record high.

Just after 3 p.m. EDT, the Dow was off 50.65 points at 7,332.76, and the drop activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. On Tuesday, the Dow rose 37.50 points to a record 7,383.41.
